chunks: I heard him saying: The Messenger of God (peace be upon him and his family) said:

'Shall I not inform you all about the most evil of your women? She is the one who is disgraced among her own family yet arrogant toward her husband; the sterile one, the vengeful one, who has no qualms about anything indecent; the one who displays herself (to strangers) whenever her husband is away from her, but becomes reserved and chaste when he is present — she does not listen to his words nor obey his instructions; and whenever her husband is alone with her she withholds herself from him, just as a stubborn animal resists being ridden, not accepting any excuse from him and not forgiving him any mistake.'

key_terms.الذَّلِيلَةُ: the disgraced/humiliated one — she lacks honor among her own family
key_terms.الصَّعْبَةُ: the stubborn/difficult animal — metaphor for a mare or camel that refuses to be mounted
key_terms.الْحَصَانُ: the chaste/fortress-like one — here used ironically: 'fortress' against her husband
key_terms.الْحَقُودُ: the vengeful/grudge-bearing one — harboring resentment rather than forgiving
key_terms.الْعَزِيزَةُ: the arrogant/domineering one — she overpowers and controls her husband
key_terms.الْعَقِيمُ: the barren/sterile one — childlessness sometimes associated with divine disfavor in classical Islamic ethics
key_terms.الْمُتَبَرِّجَةُ: the one who uncovers and displays herself (tabarruj) — immodesty especially in husband's absence
key_terms.بَعْلِهَا: her husband (ba'l) — classical Quranic term for husband, emphasizing her authority relationship

ai.seo_question: What did the Prophet Muhammad say are the characteristics of the most evil women?
ai.summary: This hadith transmits a prophetic description of the most reprehensible qualities in a woman, as reported by Jabir ibn Abdillah al-Ansari who heard the Imam (AS) quoting the Prophet (SAWW). The Prophet enumerates a cluster of moral failings centered on hypocrisy, hostility, and insubordination within marriage — being dishonored among her own kin yet domineering with her husband, immodest in his absence and cold when he is present. The original audience of early Islamic society would have understood these traits as violations of the marital contract, the spirit of mutual respect, and the virtue of 'iffah (chastity), and this teaching served as a normative guide for community members seeking righteous spouses.
word_analysis: the one who displays herself (to strangers)

en.hubeali:
A number of our companions, from Sahl Bin Ziyad and Muhammad Bin Yaha, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad and Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, altogether from Ibn Mahboub, form Ali Bin Raib, from Abu Hamza, from Jabir Bin Abdullah who said, 
‘I heard him<sup>asws</sup> saying: ‘Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> said: ‘

Shall I inform you all with the most evil of your women? (She is the one who is) the disgraced among her family, and (despite being) dear with her husband, she is the sterile, the vengeful, who does not have any qualms from ugliness, the welcoming (to others) whenever her husband is absent from her, the one who is reserved when she is with him; whenever he is present she does not listen to his words nor does she obey his instructions; and whenever he husband is alone with her she prevents him just like the stubborn animal prevents from being ridden, not accepting any excuses from him nor forgiving any of his mistakes’.
en.sarwar: 1. A number of our people have narrated from Sahl ibn Ziyad and Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad and Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father all from ibn Mahbub from ibn Ri’ab from abu Hamzah from Jabir who has said the following: “I once heard abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, saying that the Messenger of Allah, O Allah, grant compensation to Muhammad and his family worthy of their services to Your cause, has said,

‘If you like I can tell you who are of the worst kind of your women. She is the one who is undignified in her family, flattered by her husband, barren, spiteful, who does not abstain from indecency, roams around to show off in the absence of her husband and very reserved when her husband is present. She does not listen to his words and does not obey his orders and in private she refuses to yield to him like recalcitrant animal who refuses to allow riding. She does not accept any of his excuses and does not forgive any of his sins.’”
